name: Lẩu gà lá é
summary: Chicken hotpot scented with lá é, the herb Da Lat cooks put in the pot on a cool day.
origin: A Da Lat hotpot. Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note and a Yersin listing both name lẩu gà lá é.
taste: Quán Hạnh’s listing says the leaf looks like cinnamon and the smell is like lemongrass, and that the kitchen uses gà ta.
The food-tour note says Tao Ngộ’s broth is fragrant and hot with chili, and the chicken is firm and sweet. That is one door’s description.
howToEat: Order the pot for the table. Hạnh sets out a salt-and-pepper dip and whole green chili.
A citywide hour is Check on arrival. Hạnh prints 10:00–23:00.
where: Lẩu gà lá é Tao Ngộ, 5 đường 3 tháng 4, about 2 km from Xuan Huong Lake. Lẩu gà lá é 668, 2B Chu Văn An. Quán Hạnh, 6 Yersin, also called the old Thống Nhất.
priceBand: The food-tour note prints 20,000–100,000 VND a person at Tao Ngộ and at 668. Hạnh prints 200,000–350,000 VND and does not say whether that is a person or a pot. The figures are not averaged.
